cornerCallouts: The run down to Turn 1, the Remus Kurve, is always a key overtaking opportunity on this layout.
Turn 2, the Schlossgold Kurve, is a crucial corner for setting up the exit speed onto the back straight.
The drivers will need to be precise through Turn 3, managing the car perfectly through the Jochen Rindt Kurve.
Turn 4, the Niki Lauda Kurve, is a quick right-hander that demands commitment.
The sweeping Turn 5 provides a brief moment of respite before the final challenge.
Turn 6, the Red Bull Mobile Kurve, is the final chance to make up time before the start/finish straight.
The braking zone into the Remus Kurve is where we often see late lunges and daring overtakes.
The exit of the Schlossgold Kurve is critical, as a good run will set you up perfectly for the back straight and a potential DRS opportunity.
strategyPoints: Tire degradation will be a significant factor, even on this short circuit, as the drivers push hard from start to finish.
With the shorter lap, the pit window is tighter, making strategy calls even more crucial.
Fuel management will be key. Carrying too much fuel will compromise lap time, but running dry is not an option.
The undercut could be powerful on this layout, given the short lap time and the potential for clean air after a pit stop.
A one-stop strategy seems likely, but the teams will need to carefully manage tire wear to make it work.
Track position is vital, as overtaking can be tricky, even with the DRS zones on this short configuration.
The teams will be monitoring the weather closely, as a sudden downpour could throw the strategy out the window.
The shorter lap time means more opportunities for Safety Cars, which could dramatically alter the race outcome.
weatherCommentary: The Styrian mountains can bring unpredictable weather, so a sudden shower could dramatically change the complexion of the race.
The wind direction can have a significant impact on the car's balance, especially through the faster corners.
The elevation changes around the Red Bull Ring can affect the airflow and grip levels.
The temperature is rising, which will further increase tire degradation on this demanding circuit.
There's a chance of thunderstorms later in the afternoon, which could lead to a chaotic finish.
